question: What power arises from continually contemplating a smoky-colored form?
premises: A smoky-colored form is to be contemplated always.
The triple world is named as the object affected.
The power to shake it is stated.
inference: Constant contemplation of a smoky-colored form grants the power to shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The object that is smoky-colored is implied rather than explicitly named.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoky-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
